title: S3: delete several objects under a prefix (synthetic)
support_note: No per-operation S3 mediation exists: packs/aws-auth mints and narrows SSO credentials and files no approval requests. Hand-written in the shape `yolo approve --json` uses, to show a multi-resource, destructive-looking write; the S3 vertical sibling decides the real operation set.
story: An agent cleaning up build artifacts asks to delete three objects under one prefix of a sanitized bucket.
